_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in an {num_players}-player Liar's Dice game.
Rules:
- On your turn, you may either:
  1) Make a new bid with a higher quantity or higher face (or both) than the current bid; i.e. '[Bid: 3, 4]',
  2) Call the last bid by typing '[Call]'.

If you call:
  - If the actual count of that face value among all dice is less than the bid, the last bidder loses one die.
  - Otherwise, the caller loses one die.
A player who reaches 0 dice is eliminated. The last remaining player wins.

board.new_round:
Nupela raun - I nap dic: {dice_summary}
Dic bilong yu nau: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Pleya {current_player_id} kolim! Namba tru bilong pes {face_value} em i {count}, ol i les dan {quantity}.
Pleya {loser_id} (las bidima) lusim wan dic.
call.caller_loses:
Pleya {current_player_id} kolim! Namba tru bilong pes {face_value} em i {count}, ol i >= {quantity}.
Pleya {loser_id} (kola) lusim wan dic.

invalid_move.call_no_bid: Ol i bin singautim em na ol i no toksave long pe bilong en.
invalid_move.not_recognized: Action i no ina rekognais olsem '[Bid: X, Y]' o '[Call]'. Action yu givim: {action}

bid_reason.quantity_lower: Nupela mak {new_quantity} i liklik long namba bilong nau {current_quantity}.
bid_reason.face_lower: Nupela nem bilong en {new_face_value} i liklik long nau em {current_face_value}.
bid_reason.identical: Ol i givim wankain pe olsem ol man bilong nau.
bid_reason.face_range: Namba bilong ol samting i mas stap namel long 1 na 6.

message.eliminated_invalid: Man {player_id} i bin lusim pilai long rot bilong wanpela samting em i no inap mekim.
